_date: DERIVED — Friday 5 March 2027. NOT a collection day, which is the point.
_night: A night shift. Every couple of shifts the round runs after dark: the scene takes a flat wash, almost nobody is out on their own lawn, and the armadillo and the raccoon are abroad. Authored rather than derived from the level number — which shifts are nights is a pacing decision.
_teaching: Friday. The same bins that were legal on Level 2 are now a finding — the object did not change, the day did. Also the first return visits: two addresses you have already ruled on, one fixed and one not.
briefing: Friday. Not a collection day. Containers at the curb are outside the window today. Two of these addresses you have seen before.
_cameos: Garret and Sonya with Lani, Scott and Rachel with Moxy. A night shift, so these are the only people crossing anything — the lawns are empty and the sidewalk is not.
story: Second week. People are starting to recognise the clipboard.
Two addresses on today's route you have already ruled on. The file will tell you which.
It is Friday. Article IX allows Tuesday and Wednesday. It is neither.

artifact.title: On the route sheet
artifact.text: A name has been whited out beneath yours. The correction fluid is old and slightly yellow.

lots._teaching: The turn. Same lot, same bins, different day — and now they are citable.

violations.why: At the curb on a Friday. The window is Tuesday and Wednesday.

lots._teaching: A return visit that FIXED it. They were cited for weeds on Level 2 and the turf is clear now — passing an address with a history is not the same as passing a clean one.

decoys.why: Screened from the right-of-way. Compliant on any day, Friday included.

lots._teaching: A return visit that did NOT fix it. The fence they were warned about on Level 2 is still down. Under a notice-only level this is a second warning; from Level 5 it is a fine.

violations.why: Still missing members. Warned on 3 March and unrepaired.
Unbordered weed growth in the front turf.

lots._teaching: Clean, with a car on the drive. A car is clickable and citing one is a strike — nothing live covers a vehicle parked on its own paving.
Close on the Friday lesson stated plainly: bins out, no screening, wrong day.

violations.why: At the curb on a Friday.
